changelog: ONT 16S (Emu): reference-based chimera removal (VSEARCH --uchime_ref) is now OFF by default. On TH-BIOENTIST-00004 it removed 30% of PGU-16S_full, almost all of it one genus (Paenimyroides 37.6k → 10.7k reads, -72%) while every other genus moved 2-10% — genuine reads of a taxon the reference covers poorly were scored as chimeras. Emu's own method applies no chimera filter. It can still be switched on per run (beta: 'Chimera removal (VSEARCH)'; CLI: --chimera). The PDF report states which applied. emu_pipeline.py and report_builder.py need no restart; the new checkbox reaches the pipeline after a backend restart.

previous.changelog: Beta: 'Run again' button on finished amplicon jobs — runs the pipeline again on the same input files with the recorded settings (thread count can be changed), e.g. after installing chopper / VSEARCH. The job's current results are replaced. ONT 16S new-job form gets a CPU threads field (default 8; Emu used to run on 4). Frontend only, no restart needed.
